newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello says RBA gold sales always possible.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello says RBA gold sales always possible.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Friday the Reserve of Bank of Australia (RBA) always has the possibility of selling its gold reserves under consideration.
The RBA said late on Thursday that it had sold 167 tonnes of gold in the past six months, cutting its gold reserves by two-thirds.

"In relation to its reserves it (the RBA) at all times make sure that it's got that under consideration," Costello told reporters when asked whether the central bank would consider further sales of its gold assets.
The RBA gold sales, which has reduced the central bank's reserves to 80 tonnes, contributed to a 12-year slump in the gold price on Thursday.
Costello also told reporter that gold miners had no right to be angry because gold was used for many purposes and was traded on international markets.
Australia produces about 300 tonnes of gold a year, making it the world's third-largest gold producer.
